paragraphs.text: Our becoming does not end at the skin. We live inside relationships with land, food, plants, seasons, homes, watersheds, communities and innumerable living beings.
My earth work is rooted in remembering those relationships, and creating landscapes and ways of living that participate more consciously in them.
